items.html: And the third aspect was afterward, then, on the eve of Sabbath, on the day Adam HaRishon was created, in the afternoon (bein ha-arbayim), for that is the time called "the addition to the Sabbath," and it is not yet a complete Sabbath. And the matter is this: behold, after the midpoint of the day of that eve of Sabbath, it has already been explained that Yetzira and Assiya rose to the place of ZA and his Nukva of Atzilut; however, only the first four of Assiya rose, while the six lower [Sefirot] remained outside Atzilut, in the world of Beria, and this is still not complete holiness.
